en.headline: Woman in her 60s found unconscious at Kwun Tong swimming pool
en.dek: Police said a woman in her sixties was discovered unresponsive beside the pool at about 8:10am on Saturday and was taken to United Christian Hospital.
body: A woman in her sixties was found unconscious at Kwun Tong Swimming Pool on Saturday morning and taken to hospital, police said.

Officers received a report at about 8:10am that a female swimmer in her sixties had been found unconscious at the pool on Tsui Ping Road. She was rescued and sent by ambulance to United Christian Hospital for treatment.
The cause of the incident remained under investigation. Police did not rule out the possibility that the woman had been in difficulties in the water.

zh.headline: 觀塘游泳池六旬女子疑遇溺昏迷送院
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六早上約8時10分接報，一名六十多歲女泳客在觀塘游泳池昏迷不醒，已送聯合醫院搶救。
body: 一名六十多歲女子周六早上在觀塘游泳池被發現昏迷，送院搶救。
警方約於早上8時10分接獲報案，指翠屏道2號觀塘游泳池一名六十多歲女泳客昏迷不醒，懷疑遇溺。事主獲救後由救護車送往聯合醫院。
事件起因仍有待調查。警方不排除事主在水中遇險。
